name: personal-cosmic-journal
description: Telegram Bot and Telegram WebApp for Personal Cosmic Journal

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pcj/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pcj/server && npm run build --workspace=@pcj/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@pcj/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pcj/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pcj/web
scripts.check:supabase: npm run build && deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/api/index.ts supabase/functions/telegram-webhook/index.ts supabase/functions/process-horoscope-notifications/index.ts
scripts.deploy:supabase:functions: npm run build && supabase functions deploy api --no-verify-jwt && supabase functions deploy telegram-webhook --no-verify-jwt && supabase functions deploy process-horoscope-notifications --no-verify-jwt
